decision.summary: A multi-axis coherent displacement initiates near index 684: U jumps sharply upward (~+23 MAD), E drops sharply (~−6 MAD), and N dips delayed (~−3 MAD). U and E remain offset through end of allowed context (729); N does not recover. No opposing return observed for any axis within [645,729], so temporary offset cannot be confirmed—only uncertain.

intervals.observation: U-component shows a sharp upward jump near index 684–685 (from ~−10.3 to +13.3 MAD), followed by a sustained plateau at high positive values (+10 to +13 MAD) through 729; E-component drops sharply (~−14 to −8 MAD) around same index, then partially recovers but remains offset negative; N-component dips delayed (~−8.6 to −11.2 MAD) peaking near 689–690, with no clear return to pre-event level. Return phase is incomplete/unobserved in U and E within allowed context; N shows no reversal. Multi-axis coherence supports transient displacement, but absence of full return makes status uncertain.
